name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Checkbox with optional label and description, including the indeterminate state. CheckboxGroup shares state across several checkboxes (plain or bordered list layout) and supports a parent "select all" checkbox. An explicit aria-label takes precedence over the visible label; keep both consistent for WCAG 2.5.3 (label in name).
author: gntik-ai
